bull.b: Objective, multi-domain recovery signals could differentiate NVG-291 from symptomatic treatments and support advancement into Phase 3. If replicated, the evidence may strengthen regulatory credibility and partnership potential in chronic spinal cord injury.

The substantially larger cash balance provides funding capacity for ongoing clinical development and operations. This improves near-term execution flexibility, although the benefit depends on the pace of future cash consumption.

Minimal conventional debt reduces interest burden and refinancing risk while preserving flexibility to fund research through equity or partnerships. The larger asset base also indicates stronger capitalization than in prior periods.

bear.b: NervGen has no recurring product revenue to fund operations because NVG-291 remains in development. Financial performance therefore depends on clinical progress and future financing or partnering, leaving the business exposed to development setbacks.

Worsening negative operating cash flow indicates that advancing the pipeline is consuming capital at an increasing rate. Continued burn will shorten the effective runway and may force additional equity issuance or other external funding.

The ATM facility provides financing flexibility but establishes a durable source of potential dilution while the company remains pre-revenue. Additional share issuance can reduce existing ownership and may remain necessary as clinical spending rises.
